Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa: parist: Circuit diagram, not to scale: measurement of a battery. On the left is the battery under investigation, positive terminal at the top. From the positive terminal a wire runs along the top through the ammeter A to the right and down through an adjustable resistor R back to the negative terminal. The voltmeter V is connected directly across the terminals of the battery. Purple arrows show the direction of the current I from the positive terminal through the load to the negative terminal.
Kuvaaja: pariston napajännite U volttein: Graph: terminal voltage U of the battery in volts as a function of the current I in amperes. Six black points at currents 0.10–0.60 A; the voltage falls from 4.48 V to 3.89 V. A straight line has been fitted to the points, passing between the points, and it has been extended as a dashed line to the vertical axis at 4.60 V. The points (0.10 A; 4.48 V) and (0.60 A; 3.88 V) are marked on the line, with a slope triangle between them in which the change in current is 0.50 A and the change in voltage is −0.60 V. The scale of the vertical axis starts at 3.6 V.
Kytkentäkaavio, ei mittakaavassa: mökin: Circuit diagram, not to scale: cabin lighting. On the left is a 12 volt battery, positive terminal at the top. From the positive terminal a wire runs along the top through the fuse and the cable resistance Rc to two lamps connected in parallel. Lamp A is marked 12 V, 24 W and lamp B 12 V, 12 W. The lower wire returns from the lamps to the negative terminal of the battery. Purple arrows show the direction of the current.
Kaaviokuva, ei mittakaavassa: ruiskumaal: Schematic diagram, not to scale: the electric field of spray painting. At the top is a horizontal nozzle plate with a potential of +60 kV, and at the bottom a grounded workpiece. The distance between the plates is d. Between the plates the field lines of the uniform electric field are green straight lines from top to bottom, and the field is marked with the vector E. Next to the nozzle plate is a positively charged paint droplet with charge q, leaving the plate.
